results.sql:
SELECT
  m.source_db,
  COUNT(*) AS material_entry_count
FROM material_entry AS m
GROUP BY m.source_db
ORDER BY m.source_db
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT sm.method_name, sm.category
FROM synthesis_method sm
ORDER BY sm.category, sm.method_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE mp.magnetic_ordering = 'ferromagnetic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS literature_reference_count
FROM literature_reference lr
WHERE lr.year >= 2020
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    lr.doi,
    lr.title
FROM literature_reference lr
WHERE lr.year = 2025
ORDER BY lr.title ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT s.crystal_system, COUNT(*) AS structure_count
FROM structure s
GROUP BY s.crystal_system
ORDER BY structure_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.band_gap > 1.0
ORDER BY ps.band_gap DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  calc.functional,
  AVG(cp.value) AS average_bulk_modulus
FROM calculated_property cp
JOIN calculation calc ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
GROUP BY calc.functional
ORDER BY calc.functional
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       se.miller_index
FROM material_entry m
JOIN surface_energy se ON se.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE se.surface_energy_j_m2 < 1.5
ORDER BY se.surface_energy_j_m2 ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN band_structure bs ON bs.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE bs.is_direct_gap = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  sm.method_name,
  COUNT(*) AS successful_synthesis_count
FROM material_synthesis ms
JOIN synthesis_method sm
  ON sm.synthesis_id = ms.synthesis_id
WHERE ms.success = TRUE
GROUP BY sm.method_name
ORDER BY successful_synthesis_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  mp.curie_temperature_k
FROM material_entry AS m
JOIN magnetic_property AS mp
  ON m.entry_id = mp.entry_id
WHERE mp.curie_temperature_k > 800
ORDER BY mp.curie_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  mp.magnetic_ordering,
  AVG(mp.total_magnetization) AS avg_total_magnetization,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_entry_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON m.entry_id = mp.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY mp.magnetic_ordering
ORDER BY mp.magnetic_ordering
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       se.miller_index,
       se.work_function
FROM material_entry m
JOIN surface_energy se ON se.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE se.work_function IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY se.work_function DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  tp.debye_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND tp.debye_temperature_k IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  gb.sigma_value,
  COUNT(*) AS grain_boundary_count,
  AVG(gb.gb_energy_j_m2) AS avg_gb_energy_j_m2
FROM grain_boundary gb
GROUP BY gb.sigma_value
ORDER BY gb.sigma_value
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON m.entry_id = mp.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN density_of_states dos ON dos.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE mp.magnetic_ordering = 'antiferromagnetic'
  AND dos.is_metallic = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  ad.domain_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.entry_id) AS material_count,
  AVG(ma.relevance_score) AS average_relevance_score
FROM application_domain ad
JOIN material_application ma
  ON ma.domain_id = ad.domain_id
GROUP BY ad.domain_id, ad.domain_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ma.entry_id) >= 40
ORDER BY material_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    m.source_db,
    m.source_material_id
FROM material_entry m
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  md.formation_energy,
  e.symbol AS dopant_element_symbol
FROM material_entry AS m
JOIN material_defect AS md
  ON md.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN defect_type AS dt
  ON dt.defect_type_id = md.defect_type_id
LEFT JOIN element AS e
  ON e.element_id = md.dopant_element_id
WHERE dt.category ILIKE '%vacancy%'
   OR dt.defect_name ILIKE '%vacancy%'
ORDER BY md.formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.source_db,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS entries_with_stability_data,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_fraction,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS average_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
GROUP BY m.source_db
ORDER BY m.source_db
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  mp.total_magnetization,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (mp.total_magnetization * cp.value / 300.0) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON m.entry_id = mp.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND mp.total_magnetization IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  sm.category,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ms.success = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS success_rate_percent,
  AVG(ms.temperature_k) AS avg_temperature_k
FROM material_synthesis ms
JOIN synthesis_method sm ON sm.synthesis_id = ms.synthesis_id
GROUP BY sm.category
ORDER BY success_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.reference_set,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
